chunks.text: Today we will talk about Sweden.
Sweden is a calm, beautiful, and green country in Northern Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Sweden?
Sweden is in Northern Europe.
It is part of a region called Scandinavia.
It is next to Norway and Finland.
To the south, it is close to Denmark.
Sweden also has a long coastline along the Baltic Sea.
What is the capital city of Sweden?
The capital city is Stockholm.
Stockholm is a city on many islands.
It has water, bridges, and old buildings.
It is clean, quiet, and very beautiful.
Other cities in Sweden include Gothenburg on the west coast, Malmo in the south near Denmark, Uppsala and Lund, university towns.
How many people live in Sweden?
About 10 -5 million people live in Sweden.
Most people live in the south or in cities.
The north of Sweden has more nature and fewer people.
Sweden is known for being safe, organized, and eco -friendly.
What language do people speak in Sweden?
People in Sweden speak Swedish.
It is the official language.
Many people also speak English very well, especially young people.
Some people speak Finnish, Arabic, or other languages at home.
Sweden is a multilingual and open society.
What is the weather like in Sweden?
Sweden has four seasons.
Spring, cool and fresh with flowers.
Summer, warm with long days.
Autumn, colorful with wind and rain.
Winter, cold with snow, especially in the north.
In the north, winter is long and dark.
In summer, the sun stays up very late, even all night in some places.
What does Sweden look like?
Sweden has forests, lakes, mountains in the north islands and coastlines.
Small towns and big cities.
Nature is very important in Sweden.
People enjoy walking, camping, and being outside.
What animals live in Sweden?
Sweden has many wild animals.
Moose, the biggest land animal in Europe.
Reindeer in the north, foxes, wolves and lynx.
Hairs, beavers, and bears.
Many birds like owls and eagles.
There are also dogs, cats, and farm animals like cows and sheep.
What do people eat in Sweden?
Swedish food is simple and healthy.
People eat potatoes, fish, and meatballs.
Bread, cheese, and vegetables.
Berries, jam, and cream.
Popular dishes include cutbullar.
Swedish meatballs with sauce and lingonberry jam.
Gravelax, cured salmon.
Rex mergulis, shrimp sandwich.
Pea soup and pancakes on Thursdays.
Cinnamon buns, sweet and soft.
What do people drink in Sweden?
People drink water, coffee.
Swedes love coffee.
Tea milk.
In summer, cold drinks like juice or lemonade.
Adults may drink beer, cider, or snaps.
A strong spirit.
What is life like in Sweden?
Life in Sweden is calm, clean, and balanced.
People work or go to school during the day.
In the evening, they enjoy family time or relax.
People like reading, going for walks, having fika, coffee, and cake with a friend.
Spending time in nature.
Work and free time are equal and important.
What are some holidays and traditions in Sweden?
Midsummer in June with flowers, dancing, and outdoor meals.
Christmas with candles, lights, and special food.
Easter, children dress as witches and get candy.
Walpurgis night, April 30th with bonfires and songs.
National day, June 6th.
People enjoy folk music, traditional costumes, and seasonal food.
Some fun facts about Sweden.
Sweden is the home of IKEA, Spotify, and ABBA.
The Swedish flag is blue and yellow.
Swedes enjoy fika almost every day.
Sweden has over 100,000 lakes.
In the north, the Sami people live and raise reindeer.
Now you know many things about Sweden.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about the seasons, animals, cities, and traditions.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
